mapper.select: select * from campus_account where username=#{username}
select * from campus_account where user_id=#{userId}
select id from user where id=#{userId} for update
select * from campus_window order by id
select * from campus_window where id=#{id}
mapper.sql: select d.*, c.name category_name, x.window_id, x.stock,x.calories,x.tags, w.name window_name,w.canteen_name, (select coalesce(sum(od.number),0) from order_detail od join orders o on o.id=od.order_id where od.dish_id=d.id and o.status=5) sold, (select round(avg(r.rating),1) from campus_review r join order_detail od on od.order_id=r.order_id where od.dish_id=d.id) rating from dish d join category c on c.id=d.category_id join campus_dish x on x.dish_id=d.id join campus_window w on w.id=x.window_id
mapper.select: x.window_id=#{windowId}order by d.id
where d.id=#{id}
mapper.update: update campus_dish x join dish d on d.id=x.dish_id set x.stock=x.stock-#{quantity} where x.dish_id=#{dishId} and x.stock>=#{quantity} and d.status=1
update campus_dish set stock=stock+#{quantity} where dish_id=#{dishId}
mapper.select: select dish_id from campus_dish where dish_id=#{dishId} for update
mapper.update: update dish d join campus_dish x on x.dish_id=d.id set x.stock=#{change.stock},d.price=#{change.price},d.status=#{change.status},d.update_time=now(),d.update_user=#{userId} where d.id=#{change.id}
mapper.select: select c.id,c.name,c.sort,c.status,(select count(*) from dish d where d.category_id=c.id) dish_count from category c where c.type=1 order by c.sort,c.id
select id,name,sort,status from category where id=#{id} and type=1 for update
select count(*) from dish where name=#{name} and id != #{excludeId}
select (select count(*) from order_detail where dish_id=#{id})+(select count(*) from setmeal_dish where dish_id=#{id})
mapper.update: update category set name=#{category.name},sort=#{category.sort},status=#{category.status},update_time=now(),update_user=#{userId} where id=#{category.id} and type=1
mapper.select: select count(*) from category where name=#{name} and id != #{excludeId}
select (select count(*) from dish where category_id=#{id})+(select count(*) from setmeal where category_id=#{id})
mapper.delete: delete from category where id=#{id} and type=1
mapper.select: select * from campus_slot where window_id=#{windowId} and service_date=#{date} order by start_time
select * from campus_slot where id=#{id} for update
mapper.update: update campus_slot set reserved=reserved+1 where id=#{id} and reserved<capacity
update campus_slot set reserved=reserved-1 where id=#{id} and reserved>0
mapper.select: select order_id from campus_order where user_id=#{userId} and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.sql: select o.id,o.number,o.status,o.user_id,o.amount,o.pay_status,o.pay_method,o.order_time,o.cancel_reason,o.rejection_reason,o.remark, case when o.pay_method=2 then 'alipay' else 'demo' end payment_channel, a.display_name student_name,a.username student_no, co.window_id,co.slot_id,co.pickup_code,co.demo,co.picked_up_at,w.canteen_name,w.name window_name,w.location, s.service_date,s.start_time,s.end_time,exists(select 1 from campus_review r where r.order_id=o.id) reviewed from orders o join campus_order co on co.order_id=o.id join campus_account a on a.user_id=o.user_id join campus_window w on w.id=co.window_id join campus_slot s on s.id=co.slot_id
mapper.select: o.user_id=#{userId}and co.window_id=#{windowId}order by o.id desc limit 100
where o.id=#{id}
select id from orders where number=#{number}
select id from orders where id=#{id} for update
mapper.update: update campus_order set pickup_code=#{code} where order_id=#{id}
update campus_order co join orders o on o.id=co.order_id set co.slot_id=#{slotId},o.estimated_delivery_time=#{start} where co.order_id=#{id}
mapper.select: select order_id from campus_order where pickup_code=#{code} and window_id=#{windowId}
mapper.update: update campus_order set picked_up_at=now() where order_id=#{id}
mapper.select: select o.id from orders o join campus_order co on co.order_id=o.id where o.status=1 and o.order_time<#{before} limit 100
select dish_id from campus_favorite where user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from campus_favorite where user_id=#{userId} and dish_id=#{dishId}
mapper.select: select id,title,content,category,date_format(published_at,'%Y-%m-%d') publishedAt from campus_notice order by published_at desc,id desc

select f.id,f.content,f.reply,date_format(f.created_at,'%m-%d %H:%i') createdAt,a.display_name displayName,w.name windowName from campus_feedback f join campus_account a on a.user_id=f.user_id join campus_window w on w.id=f.window_id f.user_id=#{userId}and f.window_id=#{windowId} order by f.id desc limit 100
mapper.update: update campus_feedback set reply=#{reply.reply} where id=#{reply.id} and window_id=#{windowId}
mapper.select: select count(*) totalOrders,coalesce(sum(case when date(o.order_time)=#{date} then 1 else 0 end),0) todayOrders,coalesce(sum(case when o.status=5 then o.amount else 0 end),0) revenue,coalesce(sum(case when o.status=2 then 1 else 0 end),0) pending,coalesce(sum(case when o.status=3 then 1 else 0 end),0) preparing,coalesce(sum(case when o.status=4 then 1 else 0 end),0) ready,coalesce(sum(case when o.status=5 then 1 else 0 end),0) completed from orders o join campus_order co on co.order_id=o.id where 1=1 and co.window_id=#{windowId}

select date_format(o.order_time,'%Y-%m-%d') day,coalesce(sum(o.amount),0) amount from orders o join campus_order co on co.order_id=o.id where 1=1 and co.window_id=#{windowId} and o.status=5 and o.order_time>=#{begin} group by day order by day

select od.name name,sum(od.number) value from order_detail od join orders o on o.id=od.order_id join campus_order co on co.order_id=o.id where 1=1 and co.window_id=#{windowId} and o.status=5 group by od.dish_id,od.name order by value desc limit 6

select c.name name,sum(od.number) value from order_detail od join orders o on o.id=od.order_id join campus_order co on co.order_id=o.id join dish d on d.id=od.dish_id join category c on c.id=d.category_id where 1=1 and co.window_id=#{windowId} and o.status=5 group by c.id,c.name order by value desc

select w.id,w.name,w.canteen_name canteenName,w.location, count(case when o.status between 1 and 5 then 1 end) reservations, count(case when o.status=2 then 1 end) pending, count(case when o.status=3 then 1 end) preparing, count(case when o.status=4 then 1 end) ready, count(case when o.status=5 then 1 end) completed from campus_window w left join campus_order co on co.window_id=w.id and co.slot_id in (select id from campus_slot where service_date=#{date}) left join orders o on o.id=co.order_id group by w.id,w.name,w.canteen_name,w.location order by w.id
select coalesce(sum(reserved),0) occupied,coalesce(sum(capacity),0) capacity,count(*) publishedSlots from campus_slot where service_date=#{date}
select start_time name,sum(reserved) value from campus_slot where service_date=#{date} group by start_time order by start_time

select right(o.number,6) orderSuffix,w.name windowName,o.status,date_format(o.order_time,'%H:%i') orderTime,s.start_time pickupTime from orders o join campus_order co on co.order_id=o.id join campus_window w on w.id=co.window_id join campus_slot s on s.id=co.slot_id order by o.id desc limit 8
